answer: We formalize Sybil resistance by bounding the transition probability kernel of a personalized PageRank diffusion initiated from a trusted anchor node. Since the spectral gap across the cut separating the honest partition from the adversarial cluster is large, the trust propagation decays exponentially. To enforce a Nash equilibrium, the lotus protocol mandates a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function paired with a slashing penalty on staking collateral. This guarantees that the expected utility of any Sybil attack remains strictly negative.
